voipred

voipred (the R package voipred.dev) evaluates clinical prediction models in a validation sample by their clinical utility, and quantifies how much the remaining uncertainty matters for the decision of whether to use them.

  • Net benefit and decision curves (nb_val()), for binary, survival and competing-risk outcomes, for one model or several compared on the same patients; with Kaplan-Meier or conditional inverse probability of censoring weights (cIPCW) for informative censoring.
  • Value-of-information analysis: the expected value of perfect information (EVPI), the probability that each model is useful and that each strategy is the best (evpi()), and the expected value of sample information of a further validation study (evsi()).
  • A Bayesian framework, which by default gives the usual net benefit, with optional prior information, including the informative prior of bayesDCA (nb_informative()).

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("amirfarahmand0/voipred_dev")

Get started

The article Introduction to voipred walks through a complete analysis: net benefit and decision curves, comparing models, value of information, prior information, survival and competing-risk outcomes, and reporting. The Reference documents every function.
